checks.name: closure_ownership
checks.evidence: Original guard performs all three observations and removes only its exact unchanged active lease under its own mutex. Wrapper performs no manual deletion and requires original status inactive, no incomplete directory, and absent lease directory before PASS. Non-PASS wrapper exits2.

checks.name: no_extra_mutations_or_retry
checks.evidence: Wrapper writes only its owned-stage evidence and invokes original verify/status. It contains no prepare/prepublish/abort/publish, financial calls, source edits, rollback, manual lease clear, or automatic retry. CLI document describes the separate root-owned lifecycle but the wrapper does not execute those commands.

required_finalization: After successful original prepare, root must preserve exact raw PR2123 lease and observed prepared_at, then bind only LEASE_SHA256 and PREPARED_AT in a separate final copy and obtain limited-diff review.
The static review grants no execution of this DRAFT and does not establish successful rehearsal, preparation, publication, or live verification.
Run final wrapper only once after authorized publication completes and all external gates are satisfied; original guard and fresh lease binding remain authoritative.
limits: No wrapper or original guard was imported or executed; no tests, host/API/browser or external writes were used. Only source reading, AST parsing and compile-only validation occurred.

Frontend request count cannot be assigned a numeric value until the actual original lease is captured. Three full rounds are performed by original verify; the returned request list represents the first round.

Wrapper prebinding checks occur before the original guard acquires its mutex; the original guard owns the mutex and checks its observed lease remains unchanged before closure. This wrapper does not introduce a new lock protocol.

A partial or missing receipt is not success. A timeout or abrupt interruption does not permit a retry, manual cleanup, or inference of lease state; root must assess preserved evidence through the original controls.
